image_description: A side-profile view of a wombat standing on grassy, dirt-covered ground. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse, greyish-brown fur. Its head is broad with small eyes and rounded ears, and a large, bare nose. Short, powerful limbs are visible, particularly the front left paw which shows distinct claws. The tail is not clearly visible due to the angle and fur coverage.
